topic.title: 15 Things Every Family Did on a 1960s Road Trip — Unthinkable Today
topic.angle: No seatbelts, kids sprawled in the back of the station wagon, paper maps, motel pools and Dad refusing to stop. A road trip just like the ones you took.
topic.why: Cars & Road Trips serisi (1/3). Outside'ın 10 Ekim 'nostalji seyahati' trendiyle örtüşüyor. ABD ve Kanada'da ortak bir anı. Kapak: ahşap panelli station wagon ve tavan bagajı.
